title: Baobab Subscription Billing Domain Definitions (ADR-SUB-0001, ADR-SHARED-011)
description: Identifiers and vocabularies of the Baobab Billing API. Billing is a projection of a Control Plane ProductSubscription: it never redefines the subscription, its classification, its tenant or its entitlement.

billingSubscriptionId.description: baobab-subscriptions-minted opaque identifier of a billing projection. Never a Kill Bill identifier.

usageRecordId.description: baobab-subscriptions-minted opaque identifier of one usage record.

billingState.description: The billing projection's business lifecycle (ADR-SUB-0003 section 5). PENDING_CONFIGURATION: a valid upstream ProductSubscription exists but billing cannot yet be established (the blockers say why). PROVISIONING: configuration exists and provider resources are being established. ACTIVE: billing is operational as its policy requires (for INTERNAL: metering at zero charge, with no monetary provider). SUSPENDED: billing deliberately suspended by a governed instruction; it does not revoke entitlement. TERMINATING: termination is in progress. TERMINATED: final for this projection. Infrastructure conditions never appear here: they are operationalCondition.

billingBlocker.description: A machine-readable reason billing cannot currently do what its policy requires (ADR-SUB-0006 section 58). Automation depends on these codes, never on message text. Precise blockers are preferred to fake readiness.

billingProviderKind.description: TEMPORARY: the development/integration provider (ADR-SUB-0001 section 6); always simulated. KILL_BILL: the real adapter (not yet implemented).

usageMetricKey.description: Implementation-neutral usage metric, e.g. api.calls, storage.gb-hours, events.published.

operationalCondition.description: Operational condition, kept separate from the business lifecycle (ADR-SUB-0003 section 11): a provider outage makes an ACTIVE projection DEGRADED, never changes its billing_state.
